safety_level.description: Safety level to disable risky functions. 0 means no filtering, 1 disables execute, 2 disables execute and filesystem functions.

include_dirs.description: Directories to search for includes and packages. Corresponds to -I option.

defines.description: Variables to define at startup. Format 'NAME' or 'NAME=VALUE'. Corresponds to -D option.

caseless.description: Parser case sensitivity. Bits: 0=tags, 1=variables, 2=entities. 0 means case sensitive. Default 3.

encoding.description: Document encoding. Valid options are 8bit or utf8.

expansion.description: Parser expansion flags. Bit sum of: 1=skip unknown tags, 2=unknown tags simple, 4=trailing star no effect, 8=unmatched end close all, 16=backslash printf, 32=remove trailing slash, 64=no remove trailing star, 128=no remove leading star, 256=no space before slash, 1024=suppress bad nested warnings, 2048=suppress missing slash warnings.

hashsize.description: Symbol lookup hash table size (prime number).

nesting_limit.description: Artificial nesting limit for macro expansion.

debug_flags.description: Debug level flags. Any of: t(trace all), a(show args), e(show expansion), c(show collect/call), x(macro id), f(file name), l(line number), p(path searches), m(module ops), i(input files), V(all above).

error_output.description: File to redirect debug and trace output. Use '-' for stderr.

input_files.description: Input HTML files to process. If empty, reads from stdin.
